## What changed

Describe the editorial, design, content-model, or operational change.

## Publishing proof

- [ ] I ran `npm run ci` locally, or the GitHub quality workflow is green.
- [ ] Draft and archived content remain private.
- [ ] New images have meaningful alternative text when needed.
- [ ] PDF and external-document links have direct-open fallbacks.
- [ ] I reviewed the Cloudflare Pages preview before merging.
- [ ] I am comfortable allowing this change to publish when merged to `main`.
